svg.title: Discharge Desk architecture
svg.desc: Four layers. Doctor: photographs the case file on a phone, then edits, prints and signs. Engine, in plain code: prepares the case, reads hospital lab-report PDFs directly, then after the AI step repairs and guards the output, runs clinical checks and fills the unit's own template. AI: a commercial multimodal model reads the handwriting, then two agents extract narrative fields and lab tables in parallel; the engine re-asks once if a lab table is malformed. Platform: isolated job per case, standby region, failure detection, run register, exact AI cost, a research study that freezes the AI draft and records edit time, hourly cleanup, a live dashboard and doctor feedback. Engine, AI and Platform run on Google Cloud.
svg.text: The engine wraps the model on both sides:
it decides what the AI reads, then checks,
repairs and formats everything it returns.
